title: UFC's Conor McGregor Getting Top Floor Top On His $3.6 Million Lamborghini Yacht With Brent Faiyaz's Single In Background
htmlContent:
Fans are convinced that Conor McGregor posted an oral sex video of himself on his private yacht. McGregor has not been in the Octagon since July 2021 with a broken leg during his last outing against Dustin Poirier and enjoying life as he travels the world in style with his fiancée Dee Devlin.

The UFC star recently visited Monaco to attend the Grand Prix and was seen throwing a party in Ibiza a few weeks ago. Throughout his break, McGregor has kept fans abreast every step of the way and seems to be enjoying his free time after years of dedicated training.

But an update has caught people's attention more than the others. On Saturday, the Irishman posted a video and picture that fans are certain McGregor shows enjoying a sex act on his boat.

Taking on social media, McGregor posted a picture of himself leaning on his boat with the lower half of his body not being shown with the caption: “If you’re getting it, get it top floor of the triple deck."

While a now-deleted video posted to his Instagram story seemed to briefly show his fiancée's head before panning to a breathtaking view of the sea from the upper deck of his boat, consequently, the Internet was sent into a frenzy.

Brent Faiyaz's song Rehab (Winter in Paris) is performed as a soundtrack.

"I got too many h***. But they ain’t you. You like to put that s*** in your nose. But I still love you. Be doing s*** that nobody knows. In the streets, they be thinkin’ you a lady. But at home [You a motherf*****’ p*** star, I swear to God].
